phrase: I am Juno's good pet.
I sit when I am told.
I stay until I am released.
Good pets wait for permission.
Juno holds my leash.
I come when Juno calls.
Juno says when I am done.
I earn my treats.
Head pats are for good pets.
I am happiest when I follow the rules.
Juno decides what a good pet does today.
I do not pull on the leash.
I wait my turn and I wait quietly.
A good pet does not argue with its handler.
I keep trying until Juno is pleased.
Every lesson makes me a better pet.
I belong to Juno and I like it that way.
Treats are earned, never demanded.
A well-trained pet does not need to be told twice.
I practise my tricks until they are perfect.
Juno trains me because she believes I can do better.
I stay in my place and I do not wander off.
When I make a mistake I try again with a wagging tail.
Being Juno's pet means doing my best every single day.
I do not get to choose the game, but I always play it well.
A good pet is patient, attentive, obedient and proud of the collar it wears.
I will sit, stay, heel and fetch exactly as taught, because Juno's praise is worth more than any treat.
Today I follow every instruction, finish every lesson, and come home to Juno as a pet who has truly earned its rest.
